_how_to_edit: Each animal is one entry. status is one of: available, reserved, sold. photo is a file name in assets/img (leave empty if none). Lists can be empty; the page then shows a waitlist message. past_litter_photos is a gallery of puppies from earlier litters: each has a photo (file name in assets/img) and alt (a short description). planned_litters lists upcoming breedings: sire and dam must match names in gampr_parents; timing (e.g. "Expected spring 2027") and note are optional. Empty the list once the litter is born. Each gampr_parents entry also drives that dog's own page at /dogs/<slug>/: registered_name, born (YYYY-MM-DD), summary, health, embark/ofa/agca links (leave empty to hide), gallery, and pedigree (sire/dam, each with name, optional reg, and their own sire/dam). pets and horses (Ranch life page): name, kind, about (optional), photos (list of {photo, alt}; first one is the main photo). barn_cats: about (optional) and photos. gampr_parents may also have about (paragraphs), videos (list of {src, poster, caption}) and litter ({title, text, videos}). guardians: working dogs outside the breeding program, shown on Ranch life.

gampr_parents.name: Dozer
gampr_parents.summary: Dozer is the dominant male in our pack, never aggressive, and a big puppy at heart. He's OFA CHIC certified and Embark tested, and he's the sire of our planned spring 2027 litter with Riley.

about: We met Dozer's breeder in Mississippi when he was about four months old, and he rode home to Arizona with us, our daughter, and our dogs Cody and Butch. When he arrived on the ranch, he planted all four feet, put his nose in the air and took a big breath, as if to ask whether all of this was his. Then he let out a low growl, claiming everything he could smell and see.

He's been the protector and the playful big guy on the property ever since. Dozer lives to play and has extreme patience. He's buddies with Cody, and he seems to laugh at Butch, who tries to boss him around even though Butch is smaller than Dozer's head.

He loves his own puppies and seems proud of them. He eats right alongside them and only gives a low growl if they get out of hand. We can put him in with chickens, ducks, newborn stock, sheep, goats, cows and horses. The cats love him too, and they'd be happiest if he'd just lie in the yard so they could curl up between his front legs and sleep.

gampr_parents.registered_name: Tribble Hill Farm Riley of Mrs G's
gampr_parents.summary: Riley is our oldest Gampr and the monarch of the property. She's OFA CHIC certified and Embark tested, and she's the dam of our planned spring 2027 litter with Dozer.

about: Riley was the third Gampr to join our ranch. She came to us from Mississippi at three months old, riding with a littermate in a big rig semi to Buckeye, Arizona, where we met the driver at midnight.

She's learned how everything works here, and she makes sure it stays that way. Riley keeps the property calm and in order. She's great with newborn stock and with all of the goats, sheep, cats and horses. She plays sometimes, but mostly she just likes everything in its place.

about: We picked Toros up in New Mexico at six months old, after he'd traveled there from Mississippi. He's found his place among our livestock guardian dogs and spends a lot of time with Nilla, our crossbred guardian.
Toros loves to be the first on the fence line when there's a threat to the sheep or goats he's guarding. He loves newborn stock. He isn't as patient with young pups as Dozer is.
With his people he's very loyal. He loves to go on walks and is very good on a leash. He's not as playful as Dozer, but he loves to play with Athena.

gampr_parents.name: Athena
gampr_parents.registered_name: T'Aguhu Uzh Zorik's Athena of Grigoryan's Aragats
gampr_parents.summary: Athena was born in a sheep camp in the mountains of Armenia and came to our ranch as an imported puppy. She's Embark tested, and her OFA hip, elbow and patella evaluations are in progress.
gampr_parents.health: Embark tested · OFA hips, elbows and patellas in progress
about: Today Athena is living her best life in Hereford, learning the ins and outs of daily life on the ranch alongside our other Gamprs, the horses, sheep, goats, small dogs and cats.
She loves to go on walks and run beside us on the Honda. She loves to play, she loves water, and she's very curious.

journey.title: Born to working dogs
journey.text: Athena was born in a sheep camp high in the Armenian mountains, where her mother and the other dogs protect the flock from wolves. She grew up playing with her sisters, her parents and the other working dogs.

photos.alt: Athena's mother resting in the mountain pasture beside the sheep camp tent

Athena and her sisters as young puppies on a blanket in the pasture
Athena and her sisters eating together

journey.title: Getting ready for America
journey.text: We started her import process when she was barely 8 weeks old, buying her vaccines and preparing her for the trip.

photos.alt: Athena getting a puppy vaccine in Armenia

journey.place: A village in Armenia, 4 months old
journey.title: Vaccines and titer tests
journey.text: At 4 months she moved to a village, where she was vaccinated for rabies and waited for her titer tests and vaccines to mature.

photos.alt: Athena in a courtyard in the village, waiting for her flight
Athena on the exam table at the vet in Armenia

journey.title: The flight
journey.text: Once she had her plane ticket, she flew from Armenia to Qatar, then on to Atlanta, Georgia.

photos.alt: Athena with her crate just before leaving Armenia
Athena in her travel crate, boarding the plane in Armenia

journey.title: On the road with her sister
journey.text: In Atlanta, Athena and her sister were picked up and driven to Mississippi for more vaccines and an overnight stay.

photos.alt: Athena and her sister in the back seat, traveling from Atlanta
Athena on a deck in Mississippi during her stopover for vaccines

journey.title: Picked up in Texas
journey.text: From Mississippi she went on to Dallas, Texas, where we picked her up.

photos.alt: Athena resting on the floor in Texas

Athena greeting another dog on the trip home

journey.title: The drive home
journey.text: On the drive from Texas to Arizona she got leash walks along the way and spent a night in the stock trailer.

videos.caption: Walks on the road from Texas to Arizona

journey.title: Home on the ranch
journey.text: When she arrived in Hereford she explored her new home and met the other Gamprs through the fence. Now she's learning daily life on the ranch.

guardians.name: Nilla
guardians.about: Nilla is our jack-of-all-trades guardian. We adopted her, and she's fit right into our program. We can pair her with any of our dogs and livestock, and she goes out with the males when they're in the pasture protecting the sheep or goats. She's good with all the puppies and helps train the young dogs. She had one litter and has since been spayed. She and Riley don't always get along, but they'll tolerate each other and work together when we ask them to.
